notes: SHIP v1.14.462 - HOME CARD ART: SHIFT HANDOFF AND SITE PROFILE (owner directive 2026-08-14). ASSET REPLACEMENT, NOT A REDESIGN. Two supplied production images replace two heroes; no business logic, routing, Master state, handoff data, Site Profile data or navigation behaviour changed. WHAT WAS THERE. The Shift Handoff surfaces carried phantom-feat-handoff-v2.webp - the stylised portal / transfer-machine panel - in TWO places: the Work to Handoff feature hero, and a Command Deck FIELD OPERATIONS tile, which is the Home surface the directive names. The Site Profile sheet's hero slot carried phantom-feat-platforms-720.webp, the PLATFORMS art, which describes a sub-section of that sheet rather than the sheet itself. WHAT SHIPS. icons/phantom-feat-handoff-v3.webp on both handoff surfaces and icons/phantom-feat-siteprofile-960.webp on the Site Profile hero. Both are 960 by 540, which is 3x the 320px the .pfeat__art slot renders at, and both keep the sources' native 16 by 9 so height auto lays them out with no distortion. The width and height attributes moved from 720 by 720 to 960 by 540 - left at square they would have reserved the wrong box and shifted layout on load. AN OWNER OVERRIDE IS RETIRED, AND THAT IS RECORDED RATHER THAN DONE QUIETLY. The old handoff art shipped baked SOURCE_SYNC 88% and STEP 4 OF 9 text under an explicit 2026-07-21 ruling whose comment said do NOT correct it back. The new directive retires that image and forbids baked labels, percentages and fake telemetry in this artwork. The later ruling wins, the override is spent, and the note now says so in place so nobody restores the old art citing the old permission. Neither replacement carries any readable text. NO NEW DOORS. Section 8 asks for the Site Profile artwork on a Site/System page with a Site Profile hero and forbids creating a duplicate door to show it. That hero slot already existed on the Site Profile sheet, so the asset swapped in place and no surface was added. Both handoff surfaces point at ONE canonical asset. PERFORMANCE. Converted through Playwright's Chromium canvas at q0.88, the same path proven at .456 - there is no cwebp, sharp or ImageMagick on this box and none was installed. The 238 KB source JPG became a 43 KB webp and the 1822 KB source PNG became 56 KB. Against the 1.8 MB PNG going anywhere near PRECACHE_URLS, that matters. The two retired assets stay on disk, orphaned-but-retained per repo precedent; only their precache entries went, which also keeps the legacy rip cord byte-compatible. MEASURED AT 390 BY 844: the Site Profile hero renders 320 by 180 at ratio 1.778, exactly the source aspect. The Command Deck tile renders 324 by 209 under background-size cover with the tablet exchange centred, and .cs-op-scrim already supplies the dark gradient the card text needs, so no new overlay was invented. No failed image requests. ⚠ NOT VERIFIED HERE: the Work to Handoff feature hero measured 0 by 0 in the harness because that sub-surface did not come up from the automated door; the asset is wired and loads, but its on-screen framing is unconfirmed and is check 2 of the device pass. GATES: three-stamp lockstep at .462, inline blocks compile, node --check sw.js, valid JSON, brace balance, 0 bare LF, 0 mojibake. DEVICE-VERIFY: Home FIELD OPERATIONS shows the tablet exchange with no portal/machine art anywhere; Work to Handoff shows the same image framed sensibly; SITE PROFILE shows the technician-with-tablet hero; all three survive going offline.
